newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan March workers remittances fell 13.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan March workers remittances fell 13.2 pct.

text.p: Transfers of Moroccan expatriates dropped 13.2 percent to 3.5 billion dirhams ($383.4 million) in March 1997 compared with the same period last year, the Statistics Directorate said.
In its monthly newsletter received on Tuesday, the directorate said remittances of Moroccan workers abroad reached 4.1 billion dirhams in March 1996.
The directorate made no comment on the variation between the two periods.
An estimated 1.5 million Moroccans live abroad including 670,000 in France, officials said.
